propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded via built-in local_to_jira_status and jira_to_local_status; projects needing remaps or collapses have no safe round-trip path
Config-driven mapping must resolve per-project via S1 mapping_config.resolve_for_project(), merging builtin ← default ← projects.<KEY> to produce an effective forward status map
Unmapped statuses must drift (omit status field, leave Jira unchanged) with a deduped non-fatal warning, never coerce or fail
Outbound rebar-status:<local> labels must be stamped only when the config-resolved Jira target differs from the built-in canonical name, enabling lossless inbound recovery without a reverse map
Fetcher known-set and preflight validation must be widened to include config-declared status names beyond built-in keys
A shared derived helper must replace the duplicated rebar-status label literal to generate recovery vocabulary from all possible local status values
